verses.proverbs 1:1: Proverbs 1:1 The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:2: Proverbs 1:2 To know wisdom and instruction, To perceive the words of understanding,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:3: Proverbs 1:3 To receive the instruction of wisdom, Justice, judgment, and equity;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:4: Proverbs 1:4 To give prudence to the simple, To the young man knowledge and discretion"”(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:5: Proverbs 1:5 A wise man will hear and increase learning, And a man of understanding will attain wise counsel,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:6: Proverbs 1:6 To understand a proverb and an enigma, The words of the wise and their riddles.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:7: Proverbs 1:7 The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, But fools despise wisdom and instruction.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:8: Proverbs 1:8 My son, hear the instruction of your father, And do not forsake the law of your mother;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:9: Proverbs 1:9 For they will be a graceful ornament on your head, And chains about your neck.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:10: Proverbs 1:10 My son, if sinners entice you,  Do not consent.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:11: Proverbs 1:11 If they say, "Come with us, Let us lie in wait to shed blood; Let us lurk secretly for the innocent without cause;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:12: Proverbs 1:12 Let us swallow them alive like Sheol, And whole, like those who go down to the Pit;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:13: Proverbs 1:13 We shall find all kinds of precious possessions, We shall fill our houses with spoil;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:14: Proverbs 1:14 Cast in your lot among us, Let us all have one purse""”(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:15: Proverbs 1:15 My son, do not walk in the way with them,  Keep your foot from their path;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:16: Proverbs 1:16 For their feet run to evil, And they make haste to shed blood.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:17: Proverbs 1:17 Surely, in vain the net is spread In the sight of any bird;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:18: Proverbs 1:18 But they lie in wait for their own blood, They lurk secretly for their own lives.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:19: Proverbs 1:19 So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain; It takes away the life of its owners.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:20: Proverbs 1:20 Wisdom calls aloud outside; She raises her voice in the open squares.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:21: Proverbs 1:21 She cries out in the chief concourses, At the openings of the gates in the city She speaks her words:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:22: Proverbs 1:22 "How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? For scorners delight in their scorning, And fools hate knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:23: Proverbs 1:23 Turn at my rebuke; Surely I will pour out my spirit on you; I will make my words known to you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:24: Proverbs 1:24 Because I have called and you refused, I have stretched out my hand and no one regarded,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:25: Proverbs 1:25 Because you disdained all my counsel, And would have none of my rebuke,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:26: Proverbs 1:26 I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your terror comes,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:27: Proverbs 1:27 When your terror comes like a storm, And your destruction comes like a whirlwind, When distress and anguish come upon you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:28: Proverbs 1:28 "Then  they will call on me, but I will not answer; They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:29: Proverbs 1:29 Because they hated knowledge And did not choose the fear of the LORD,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:30: Proverbs 1:30 They would have none of my counsel And despised my every rebuke.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:31: Proverbs 1:31 Therefore they shall eat the fruit of their own way, And be filled to the full with their own fancies.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:32: Proverbs 1:32 For the turning away of the simple will slay them, And the complacency of fools will destroy them;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 1:33: Proverbs 1:33 But whoever listens to me will dwell safely, And will be secure, without fear of evil."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:1: Proverbs 2:1 My son, if you receive my words, And treasure my commands within you,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:2: Proverbs 2:2 So that you incline your ear to wisdom, And apply your heart to understanding;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:3: Proverbs 2:3 Yes, if you cry out for discernment, And lift up your voice for understanding,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:4: Proverbs 2:4 If you seek her as silver, And search for her as for hidden treasures;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:5: Proverbs 2:5 Then you will understand the fear of the LORD, And find the knowledge of God.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:6: Proverbs 2:6 For the LORD gives wisdom; From His mouth come knowledge and understanding;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:7: Proverbs 2:7 He stores up sound wisdom for the upright;  He is a shield to those who walk uprightly;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:8: Proverbs 2:8 He guards the paths of justice, And preserves the way of His saints.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:9: Proverbs 2:9 Then you will understand righteousness and justice, Equity and every good path.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:10: Proverbs 2:10 When wisdom enters your heart, And knowledge is pleasant to your soul,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:11: Proverbs 2:11 Discretion will preserve you;  Understanding will keep you,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:12: Proverbs 2:12 To deliver you from the way of evil, From the man who speaks perverse things,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:13: Proverbs 2:13 From those who leave the paths of uprightness To walk in the ways of darkness;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:14: Proverbs 2:14 Who rejoice in doing evil, And delight in the perversity of the wicked;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:15: Proverbs 2:15 Whose ways are crooked, And who are devious in their paths;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:16: Proverbs 2:16 To deliver you from the immoral woman,  From the seductress who flatters with her words,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:17: Proverbs 2:17 Who forsakes the companion of her youth, And forgets the covenant of her God.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:18: Proverbs 2:18 For her house leads down to death, And her paths to the dead;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:19: Proverbs 2:19 None who go to her return, Nor do they regain the paths of life"”(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:20: Proverbs 2:20 So you may walk in the way of goodness, And keep to the paths of righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:21: Proverbs 2:21 For the upright will dwell in the land, And the blameless will remain in it;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 2:22: Proverbs 2:22 But the wicked will be cut off from the earth, And the unfaithful will be uprooted from it.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:1: Proverbs 3:1 My son, do not forget my law,  But let your heart keep my commands;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:2: Proverbs 3:2 For length of days and long life And peace they will add to you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:3: Proverbs 3:3 Let not mercy and truth forsake you;  Bind them around your neck,  Write them on the tablet of your heart,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:4: Proverbs 3:4 And so find favor and high esteem In the sight of God and man.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:5: Proverbs 3:5 Trust in the LORD with all your heart,  And lean not on your own understanding;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:6: Proverbs 3:6 In all your ways acknowledge Him, And He shall direct your paths.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:7: Proverbs 3:7 Do not be wise in your own eyes; Fear the LORD and depart from evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:8: Proverbs 3:8 It will be health to your flesh, And strength to your bones.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:9: Proverbs 3:9 Honor the LORD with your possessions, And with the firstfruits of all your increase;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:10: Proverbs 3:10 So your barns will be filled with plenty, And your vats will overflow with new wine.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:11: Proverbs 3:11 My son, do not despise the chastening of the LORD, Nor detest His correction;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:12: Proverbs 3:12 For whom the LORD loves He corrects,  Just as a father the son in whom he delights.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:13: Proverbs 3:13 Happy is the man who finds wisdom, And the man who gains understanding;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:14: Proverbs 3:14 For her proceeds are better than the profits of silver, And her gain than fine gold.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:15: Proverbs 3:15 She is more precious than rubies, And all the things you may desire cannot compare with her.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:16: Proverbs 3:16 Length of days is in her right hand, In her left hand riches and honor.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:17: Proverbs 3:17 Her ways are ways of pleasantness, And all her paths are peace.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:18: Proverbs 3:18 She is a tree of life to those who take hold of her, And happy are all who retain her.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:19: Proverbs 3:19 The LORD by wisdom founded the earth; By understanding He established the heavens;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:20: Proverbs 3:20 By His knowledge the depths were broken up, And clouds drop down the dew.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:21: Proverbs 3:21 My son, let them not depart from your eyes"” Keep sound wisdom and discretion;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:22: Proverbs 3:22 So they will be life to your soul And grace to your neck.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:23: Proverbs 3:23 Then you will walk safely in your way, And your foot will not stumble.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:24: Proverbs 3:24 When you lie down, you will not be afraid; Yes, you will lie down and your sleep will be sweet.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:25: Proverbs 3:25 Do not be afraid of sudden terror, Nor of trouble from the wicked when it comes;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:26: Proverbs 3:26 For the LORD will be your confidence, And will keep your foot from being caught.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:27: Proverbs 3:27 Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due, When it is in the power of your hand to do so.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:28: Proverbs 3:28 Do not say to your neighbor, "Go, and come back, And tomorrow I will give it," When you have it with you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:29: Proverbs 3:29 Do not devise evil against your neighbor, For he dwells by you for safety's sake.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:30: Proverbs 3:30 Do not strive with a man without cause, If he has done you no harm.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:31: Proverbs 3:31 Do not envy the oppressor, And choose none of his ways;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:32: Proverbs 3:32 For the perverse person is an abomination to the LORD,  But His secret counsel is with the upright.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:33: Proverbs 3:33 The curse of the LORD is on the house of the wicked, But He blesses the home of the just.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:34: Proverbs 3:34 Surely He scorns the scornful, But gives grace to the humble.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 3:35: Proverbs 3:35 The wise shall inherit glory, But shame shall be the legacy of fools.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:1: Proverbs 4:1 Hear, my children, the instruction of a father, And give attention to know understanding;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:2: Proverbs 4:2 For I give you good doctrine: Do not forsake my law.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:3: Proverbs 4:3 When I was my father's son,  Tender and the only one in the sight of my mother,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:4: Proverbs 4:4 He also taught me, and said to me: "Let your heart retain my words;  Keep my commands, and live.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:5: Proverbs 4:5 Get wisdom! Get understanding! Do not forget, nor turn away from the words of my mouth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:6: Proverbs 4:6 Do not forsake her, and she will preserve you;  Love her, and she will keep you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:7: Proverbs 4:7 Wisdom is the principal thing; Therefore get wisdom. And in all your getting, get understanding.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:8: Proverbs 4:8 Exalt her, and she will promote you; She will bring you honor, when you embrace her.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:9: Proverbs 4:9 She will place on your head an ornament of grace; A crown of glory she will deliver to you."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:10: Proverbs 4:10 Hear, my son, and receive my sayings,  And the years of your life will be many.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:11: Proverbs 4:11 I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in right paths.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:12: Proverbs 4:12 When you walk, your steps will not be hindered,  And when you run, you will not stumble.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:13: Proverbs 4:13 Take firm hold of instruction, do not let go; Keep her, for she is your life.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:14: Proverbs 4:14 Do not enter the path of the wicked, And do not walk in the way of evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:15: Proverbs 4:15 Avoid it, do not travel on it; Turn away from it and pass on.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:16: Proverbs 4:16 For they do not sleep unless they have done evil; And their sleep is taken away unless they make someone fall.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:17: Proverbs 4:17 For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:18: Proverbs 4:18 But the path of the just is like the shining sun, That shines ever brighter unto the perfect day.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:19: Proverbs 4:19 The way of the wicked is like darkness; They do not know what makes them stumble.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:20: Proverbs 4:20 My son, give attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:21: Proverbs 4:21 Do not let them depart from your eyes; Keep them in the midst of your heart;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:22: Proverbs 4:22 For they are life to those who find them, And health to all their flesh.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:23: Proverbs 4:23 Keep your heart with all diligence, For out of it spring the issues of life.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:24: Proverbs 4:24 Put away from you a deceitful mouth, And put perverse lips far from you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:25: Proverbs 4:25 Let your eyes look straight ahead, And your eyelids look right before you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:26: Proverbs 4:26 Ponder the path of your feet, And let all your ways be established.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 4:27: Proverbs 4:27 Do not turn to the right or the left; Remove your foot from evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:1: Proverbs 5:1 My son, pay attention to my wisdom; Lend your ear to my understanding,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:2: Proverbs 5:2 That you may preserve discretion, And your lips may keep knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:3: Proverbs 5:3 For the lips of an immoral woman drip honey, And her mouth is smoother than oil;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:4: Proverbs 5:4 But in the end she is bitter as wormwood, Sharp as a two-edged sword.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:5: Proverbs 5:5 Her feet go down to death,  Her steps lay hold of hell.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:6: Proverbs 5:6 Lest you ponder her path of life"” Her ways are unstable; You do not know them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:7: Proverbs 5:7 Therefore hear me now, my children, And do not depart from the words of my mouth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:8: Proverbs 5:8 Remove your way far from her, And do not go near the door of her house,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:9: Proverbs 5:9 Lest you give your honor to others, And your years to the cruel one;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:10: Proverbs 5:10 Lest aliens be filled with your wealth, And your labors go to the house of a foreigner;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:11: Proverbs 5:11 And you mourn at last, When your flesh and your body are consumed,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:12: Proverbs 5:12 And say: "How I have hated instruction, And my heart despised correction!(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:13: Proverbs 5:13 I have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, Nor inclined my ear to those who instructed me!(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:14: Proverbs 5:14 I was on the verge of total ruin, In the midst of the assembly and congregation."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:15: Proverbs 5:15 Drink water from your own cistern, And running water from your own well.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:16: Proverbs 5:16 Should your fountains be dispersed abroad, Streams of water in the streets?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:17: Proverbs 5:17 Let them be only your own, And not for strangers with you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:18: Proverbs 5:18 Let your fountain be blessed, And rejoice with the wife of your youth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:19: Proverbs 5:19 As a loving deer and a graceful doe, Let her breasts satisfy you at all times; And always be enraptured with her love.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:20: Proverbs 5:20 For why should you, my son, be enraptured by an immoral woman, And be embraced in the arms of a seductress?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:21: Proverbs 5:21 For the ways of man are before the eyes of the LORD, And He ponders all his paths.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:22: Proverbs 5:22 His own iniquities entrap the wicked man, And he is caught in the cords of his sin.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 5:23: Proverbs 5:23 He shall die for lack of instruction, And in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:1: Proverbs 6:1 My son, if you become surety for your friend, If you have shaken hands in pledge for a stranger,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:2: Proverbs 6:2 You are snared by the words of your mouth; You are taken by the words of your mouth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:3: Proverbs 6:3 So do this, my son, and deliver yourself; For you have come into the hand of your friend: Go and humble yourself; Plead with your friend.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:4: Proverbs 6:4 Give no sleep to your eyes, Nor slumber to your eyelids.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:5: Proverbs 6:5 Deliver yourself like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, And like a bird from the hand of the fowler.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:6: Proverbs 6:6 Go to the ant, you sluggard! Consider her ways and be wise,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:7: Proverbs 6:7 Which, having no captain, Overseer or ruler,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:8: Proverbs 6:8 Provides her supplies in the summer, And gathers her food in the harvest.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:9: Proverbs 6:9 How long will you slumber, O sluggard? When will you rise from your sleep?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:10: Proverbs 6:10 A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to sleep"”(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:11: Proverbs 6:11 So shall your poverty come on you like a prowler, And your need like an armed man.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:12: Proverbs 6:12 A worthless person, a wicked man, Walks with a perverse mouth;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:13: Proverbs 6:13 He winks with his eyes, He shuffles his feet, He points with his fingers;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:14: Proverbs 6:14 Perversity is in his heart,  He devises evil continually,  He sows discord.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:15: Proverbs 6:15 Therefore his calamity shall come suddenly; Suddenly he shall be broken without remedy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:16: Proverbs 6:16 These six things the LORD hates, Yes, seven are an abomination to Him:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:17: Proverbs 6:17 A proud look,  A lying tongue,  Hands that shed innocent blood,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:18: Proverbs 6:18 A heart that devises wicked plans,  Feet that are swift in running to evil,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:19: Proverbs 6:19 A false witness who speaks lies, And one who sows discord among brethren.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:20: Proverbs 6:20 My son, keep your father's command, And do not forsake the law of your mother.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:21: Proverbs 6:21 Bind them continually upon your heart; Tie them around your neck.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:22: Proverbs 6:22 When you roam, they will lead you; When you sleep, they will keep you; And when you awake, they will speak with you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:23: Proverbs 6:23 For the commandment is a lamp, And the law a light; Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:24: Proverbs 6:24 To keep you from the evil woman, From the flattering tongue of a seductress.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:25: Proverbs 6:25 Do not lust after her beauty in your heart, Nor let her allure you with her eyelids.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:26: Proverbs 6:26 For by means of a harlot A man is reduced to a crust of bread;  And an adulteress will prey upon his precious life.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:27: Proverbs 6:27 Can a man take fire to his bosom, And his clothes not be burned?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:28: Proverbs 6:28 Can one walk on hot coals, And his feet not be seared?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:29: Proverbs 6:29 So is he who goes in to his neighbor's wife; Whoever touches her shall not be innocent.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:30: Proverbs 6:30 People do not despise a thief If he steals to satisfy himself when he is starving.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:31: Proverbs 6:31 Yet when he is found, he must restore sevenfold; He may have to give up all the substance of his house.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:32: Proverbs 6:32 Whoever commits adultery with a woman lacks understanding; He who does so destroys his own soul.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:33: Proverbs 6:33 Wounds and dishonor he will get, And his reproach will not be wiped away.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:34: Proverbs 6:34 For jealousy is a husband's fury; Therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 6:35: Proverbs 6:35 He will accept no recompense, Nor will he be appeased though you give many gifts.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:1: Proverbs 7:1 My son, keep my words, And treasure my commands within you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:2: Proverbs 7:2 Keep my commands and live,  And my law as the apple of your eye.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:3: Proverbs 7:3 Bind them on your fingers; Write them on the tablet of your heart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:4: Proverbs 7:4 Say to wisdom, "You are my sister," And call understanding your nearest kin,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:5: Proverbs 7:5 That they may keep you from the immoral woman, From the seductress who flatters with her words.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:6: Proverbs 7:6 For at the window of my house I looked through my lattice,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:7: Proverbs 7:7 And saw among the simple, I perceived among the youths, A young man devoid of understanding,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:8: Proverbs 7:8 Passing along the street near her corner; And he took the path to her house(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:9: Proverbs 7:9 In the twilight, in the evening, In the black and dark night.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:10: Proverbs 7:10 And there a woman met him, With the attire of a harlot, and a crafty heart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:11: Proverbs 7:11 She was loud and rebellious,  Her feet would not stay at home.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:12: Proverbs 7:12 At times she was outside, at times in the open square, Lurking at every corner.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:13: Proverbs 7:13 So she caught him and kissed him; With an impudent face she said to him:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:14: Proverbs 7:14 "I have peace offerings with me; Today I have paid my vows.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:15: Proverbs 7:15 So I came out to meet you, Diligently to seek your face, And I have found you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:16: Proverbs 7:16 I have spread my bed with tapestry, Colored coverings of Egyptian linen.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:17: Proverbs 7:17 I have perfumed my bed With myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:18: Proverbs 7:18 Come, let us take our fill of love until morning; Let us delight ourselves with love.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:19: Proverbs 7:19 For my husband is not at home; He has gone on a long journey;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:20: Proverbs 7:20 He has taken a bag of money with him, And will come home on the appointed day."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:21: Proverbs 7:21 With her enticing speech she caused him to yield,  With her flattering lips she seduced him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:22: Proverbs 7:22 Immediately he went after her, as an ox goes to the slaughter, Or as a fool to the correction of the stocks,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:23: Proverbs 7:23 Till an arrow struck his liver.  As a bird hastens to the snare, He did not know it would cost his life.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:24: Proverbs 7:24 Now therefore, listen to me, my children; Pay attention to the words of my mouth:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:25: Proverbs 7:25 Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways, Do not stray into her paths;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:26: Proverbs 7:26 For she has cast down many wounded, And all who were slain by her were strong men.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 7:27: Proverbs 7:27 Her house is the way to hell, Descending to the chambers of death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:1: Proverbs 8:1 Does not wisdom cry out, And understanding lift up her voice?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:2: Proverbs 8:2 She takes her stand on the top of the high hill, Beside the way, where the paths meet.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:3: Proverbs 8:3 She cries out by the gates, at the entry of the city, At the entrance of the doors:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:4: Proverbs 8:4 "To you, O men, I call, And my voice is to the sons of men.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:5: Proverbs 8:5 O you simple ones, understand prudence, And you fools, be of an understanding heart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:6: Proverbs 8:6 Listen, for I will speak of excellent things, And from the opening of my lips will come right things;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:7: Proverbs 8:7 For my mouth will speak truth; Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:8: Proverbs 8:8 All the words of my mouth are with righteousness; Nothing crooked or perverse is in them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:9: Proverbs 8:9 They are all plain to him who understands, And right to those who find knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:10: Proverbs 8:10 Receive my instruction, and not silver, And knowledge rather than choice gold;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:11: Proverbs 8:11 For wisdom is better than rubies, And all the things one may desire cannot be compared with her.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:12: Proverbs 8:12 "I, wisdom, dwell with prudence, And find out knowledge and discretion.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:13: Proverbs 8:13 The fear of the LORD is to hate evil;  Pride and arrogance and the evil way And the perverse mouth I hate.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:14: Proverbs 8:14 Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom; I am understanding, I have strength.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:15: Proverbs 8:15 By me kings reign, And rulers decree justice.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:16: Proverbs 8:16 By me princes rule, and nobles, All the judges of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:17: Proverbs 8:17 I love those who love me, And those who seek me diligently will find me.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:18: Proverbs 8:18 Riches and honor are with me, Enduring riches and righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:19: Proverbs 8:19 My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, And my revenue than choice silver.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:20: Proverbs 8:20 I traverse the way of righteousness, In the midst of the paths of justice,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:21: Proverbs 8:21 That I may cause those who love me to inherit wealth, That I may fill their treasuries.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:22: Proverbs 8:22 "The  LORD possessed me at the beginning of His way, Before His works of old.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:23: Proverbs 8:23 I have been established from everlasting, From the beginning, before there was ever an earth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:24: Proverbs 8:24 When there were no depths I was brought forth, When there were no fountains abounding with water.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:25: Proverbs 8:25 Before the mountains were settled, Before the hills, I was brought forth;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:26: Proverbs 8:26 While as yet He had not made the earth or the fields, Or the primal dust of the world.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:27: Proverbs 8:27 When He prepared the heavens, I was there, When He drew a circle on the face of the deep,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:28: Proverbs 8:28 When He established the clouds above, When He strengthened the fountains of the deep,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:29: Proverbs 8:29 When He assigned to the sea its limit, So that the waters would not transgress His command, When He marked out the foundations of the earth,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:30: Proverbs 8:30 Then I was beside Him as a master craftsman;  And I was daily His delight, Rejoicing always before Him,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:31: Proverbs 8:31 Rejoicing in His inhabited world, And my delight was with the sons of men.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:32: Proverbs 8:32 "Now therefore, listen to me, my children, For blessed are those who keep my ways.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:33: Proverbs 8:33 Hear instruction and be wise, And do not disdain it.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:34: Proverbs 8:34 Blessed is the man who listens to me, Watching daily at my gates, Waiting at the posts of my doors.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:35: Proverbs 8:35 For whoever finds me finds life, And obtains favor from the LORD;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 8:36: Proverbs 8:36 But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul; All those who hate me love death."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:1: Proverbs 9:1 Wisdom has built her house, She has hewn out her seven pillars;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:2: Proverbs 9:2 She has slaughtered her meat,  She has mixed her wine, She has also furnished her table.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:3: Proverbs 9:3 She has sent out her maidens, She cries out from the highest places of the city,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:4: Proverbs 9:4 "Whoever  is simple, let him turn in here!" As for him who lacks understanding, she says to him,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:5: Proverbs 9:5 "Come,  eat of my bread And drink of the wine I have mixed.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:6: Proverbs 9:6 Forsake foolishness and live, And go in the way of understanding.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:7: Proverbs 9:7 "He who corrects a scoffer gets shame for himself, And he who rebukes a wicked man only harms himself.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:8: Proverbs 9:8 Do not correct a scoffer, lest he hate you;  Rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:9: Proverbs 9:9 Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be still wiser; Teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:10: Proverbs 9:10 "The  fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, And the knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:11: Proverbs 9:11 For by me your days will be multiplied, And years of life will be added to you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:12: Proverbs 9:12 If you are wise, you are wise for yourself, And if you scoff, you will bear it alone."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:13: Proverbs 9:13 A foolish woman is clamorous; She is simple, and knows nothing.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:14: Proverbs 9:14 For she sits at the door of her house, On a seat by the highest places of the city,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:15: Proverbs 9:15 To call to those who pass by, Who go straight on their way:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:16: Proverbs 9:16 "Whoever  is simple, let him turn in here"; And as for him who lacks understanding, she says to him,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:17: Proverbs 9:17 "Stolen  water is sweet, And bread eaten in secret is pleasant."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 9:18: Proverbs 9:18 But he does not know that the dead are there, That her guests are in the depths of hell.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:1: Proverbs 10:1 The proverbs of Solomon:  A wise son makes a glad father, But a foolish son is the grief of his mother.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:2: Proverbs 10:2 Treasures of wickedness profit nothing,  But righteousness delivers from death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:3: Proverbs 10:3 The LORD will not allow the righteous soul to famish, But He casts away the desire of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:4: Proverbs 10:4 He who has a slack hand becomes poor, But the hand of the diligent makes rich.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:5: Proverbs 10:5 He who gathers in summer is a wise son; He who sleeps in harvest is a son who causes shame.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:6: Proverbs 10:6 Blessings are on the head of the righteous, But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:7: Proverbs 10:7 The memory of the righteous is blessed, But the name of the wicked will rot.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:8: Proverbs 10:8 The wise in heart will receive commands,  But a prating fool will fall.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:9: Proverbs 10:9 He who walks with integrity walks securely, But he who perverts his ways will become known.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:10: Proverbs 10:10 He who winks with the eye causes trouble, But a prating fool will fall.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:11: Proverbs 10:11 The mouth of the righteous is a well of life, But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:12: Proverbs 10:12 Hatred stirs up strife, But love covers all sins.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:13: Proverbs 10:13 Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has understanding, But a rod is for the back of him who is devoid of understanding.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:14: Proverbs 10:14 Wise people store up knowledge, But the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:15: Proverbs 10:15 The rich man's wealth is his strong city; The destruction of the poor is their poverty.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:16: Proverbs 10:16 The labor of the righteous leads to life, The wages of the wicked to sin.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:17: Proverbs 10:17 He who keeps instruction is in the way of life, But he who refuses correction goes astray.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:18: Proverbs 10:18 Whoever hides hatred has lying lips, And whoever spreads slander is a fool.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:19: Proverbs 10:19 In the multitude of words sin is not lacking, But he who restrains his lips is wise.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:20: Proverbs 10:20 The tongue of the righteous is choice silver; The heart of the wicked is worth little.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:21: Proverbs 10:21 The lips of the righteous feed many, But fools die for lack of wisdom.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:22: Proverbs 10:22 The blessing of the LORD makes one rich, And He adds no sorrow with it.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:23: Proverbs 10:23 To do evil is like sport to a fool, But a man of understanding has wisdom.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:24: Proverbs 10:24 The fear of the wicked will come upon him, And the desire of the righteous will be granted.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:25: Proverbs 10:25 When the whirlwind passes by, the wicked is no more, But the righteous has an everlasting foundation.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:26: Proverbs 10:26 As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, So is the lazy man to those who send him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:27: Proverbs 10:27 The fear of the LORD prolongs days, But the years of the wicked will be shortened.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:28: Proverbs 10:28 The hope of the righteous will be gladness, But the expectation of the wicked will perish.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:29: Proverbs 10:29 The way of the LORD is strength for the upright, But destruction will come to the workers of iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:30: Proverbs 10:30 The righteous will never be removed, But the wicked will not inhabit the earth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:31: Proverbs 10:31 The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, But the perverse tongue will be cut out.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 10:32: Proverbs 10:32 The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, But the mouth of the wicked what is perverse.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:1: Proverbs 11:1 Dishonest scales are an abomination to the LORD, But a just weight is His delight.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:2: Proverbs 11:2 When pride comes, then comes shame; But with the humble is wisdom.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:3: Proverbs 11:3 The integrity of the upright will guide them, But the perversity of the unfaithful will destroy them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:4: Proverbs 11:4 Riches do not profit in the day of wrath, But righteousness delivers from death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:5: Proverbs 11:5 The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way aright, But the wicked will fall by his own wickedness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:6: Proverbs 11:6 The righteousness of the upright will deliver them, But the unfaithful will be caught by their lust.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:7: Proverbs 11:7 When a wicked man dies, his expectation will perish, And the hope of the unjust perishes.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:8: Proverbs 11:8 The righteous is delivered from trouble, And it comes to the wicked instead.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:9: Proverbs 11:9 The hypocrite with his mouth destroys his neighbor, But through knowledge the righteous will be delivered.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:10: Proverbs 11:10 When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices; And when the wicked perish, there is jubilation.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:11: Proverbs 11:11 By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted, But it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:12: Proverbs 11:12 He who is devoid of wisdom despises his neighbor, But a man of understanding holds his peace.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:13: Proverbs 11:13 A talebearer reveals secrets, But he who is of a faithful spirit conceals a matter.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:14: Proverbs 11:14 Where there is no counsel, the people fall; But in the multitude of counselors there is safety.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:15: Proverbs 11:15 He who is surety for a stranger will suffer, But one who hates being surety is secure.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:16: Proverbs 11:16 A gracious woman retains honor, But ruthless men retain riches.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:17: Proverbs 11:17 The merciful man does good for his own soul, But he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:18: Proverbs 11:18 The wicked man does deceptive work, But he who sows righteousness will have a sure reward.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:19: Proverbs 11:19 As righteousness leads to life, So he who pursues evil pursues it to his own death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:20: Proverbs 11:20 Those who are of a perverse heart are an abomination to the LORD, But the blameless in their ways are His delight.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:21: Proverbs 11:21 Though they join forces, the wicked will not go unpunished; But the posterity of the righteous will be delivered.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:22: Proverbs 11:22 As a ring of gold in a swine's snout, So is a lovely woman who lacks discretion.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:23: Proverbs 11:23 The desire of the righteous is only good, But the expectation of the wicked is wrath.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:24: Proverbs 11:24 There is one who scatters, yet increases more; And there is one who withholds more than is right, But it leads to poverty.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:25: Proverbs 11:25 The generous soul will be made rich,  And he who waters will also be watered himself.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:26: Proverbs 11:26 The people will curse him who withholds grain, But blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:27: Proverbs 11:27 He who earnestly seeks good finds favor,  But trouble will come to him who seeks evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:28: Proverbs 11:28 He who trusts in his riches will fall, But the righteous will flourish like foliage.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:29: Proverbs 11:29 He who troubles his own house will inherit the wind, And the fool will be servant to the wise of heart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:30: Proverbs 11:30 The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life, And he who wins souls is wise.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 11:31: Proverbs 11:31 If the righteous will be recompensed on the earth, How much more the ungodly and the sinner.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:1: Proverbs 12:1 Whoever loves instruction loves knowledge, But he who hates correction is stupid.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:2: Proverbs 12:2 A good man obtains favor from the LORD, But a man of wicked intentions He will condemn.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:3: Proverbs 12:3 A man is not established by wickedness, But the root of the righteous cannot be moved.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:4: Proverbs 12:4 An excellent wife is the crown of her husband, But she who causes shame is like rottenness in his bones.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:5: Proverbs 12:5 The thoughts of the righteous are right, But the counsels of the wicked are deceitful.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:6: Proverbs 12:6 The words of the wicked are, "Lie in wait for blood,"  But the mouth of the upright will deliver them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:7: Proverbs 12:7 The wicked are overthrown and are no more, But the house of the righteous will stand.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:8: Proverbs 12:8 A man will be commended according to his wisdom,  But he who is of a perverse heart will be despised.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:9: Proverbs 12:9 Better is the one who is slighted but has a servant, Than he who honors himself but lacks bread.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:10: Proverbs 12:10 A righteous man regards the life of his animal, But the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:11: Proverbs 12:11 He who tills his land will be satisfied with bread, But he who follows frivolity is devoid of understanding.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:12: Proverbs 12:12 The wicked covet the catch of evil men, But the root of the righteous yields fruit.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:13: Proverbs 12:13 The wicked is ensnared by the transgression of his lips,  But the righteous will come through trouble.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:14: Proverbs 12:14 A man will be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth,  And the recompense of a man's hands will be rendered to him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:15: Proverbs 12:15 The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, But he who heeds counsel is wise.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:16: Proverbs 12:16 A fool's wrath is known at once, But a prudent man covers shame.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:17: Proverbs 12:17 He who speaks truth declares righteousness, But a false witness, deceit.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:18: Proverbs 12:18 There is one who speaks like the piercings of a sword, But the tongue of the wise promotes health.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:19: Proverbs 12:19 The truthful lip shall be established forever,  But a lying tongue is but for a moment.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:20: Proverbs 12:20 Deceit is in the heart of those who devise evil, But counselors of peace have joy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:21: Proverbs 12:21 No grave trouble will overtake the righteous, But the wicked shall be filled with evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:22: Proverbs 12:22 Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, But those who deal truthfully are His delight.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:23: Proverbs 12:23 A prudent man conceals knowledge, But the heart of fools proclaims foolishness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:24: Proverbs 12:24 The hand of the diligent will rule, But the lazy man will be put to forced labor.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:25: Proverbs 12:25 Anxiety in the heart of man causes depression, But a good word makes it glad.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:26: Proverbs 12:26 The righteous should choose his friends carefully, For the way of the wicked leads them astray.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:27: Proverbs 12:27 The lazy man does not roast what he took in hunting, But diligence is man's precious possession.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 12:28: Proverbs 12:28 In the way of righteousness is life, And in its pathway there is no death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:1: Proverbs 13:1 A wise son heeds his father's instruction,  But a scoffer does not listen to rebuke.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:2: Proverbs 13:2 A man shall eat well by the fruit of his mouth, But the soul of the unfaithful feeds on violence.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:3: Proverbs 13:3 He who guards his mouth preserves his life, But he who opens wide his lips shall have destruction.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:4: Proverbs 13:4 The soul of a lazy man desires, and has nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made rich.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:5: Proverbs 13:5 A righteous man hates lying, But a wicked man is loathsome and comes to shame.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:6: Proverbs 13:6 Righteousness guards him whose way is blameless, But wickedness overthrows the sinner.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:7: Proverbs 13:7 There is one who makes himself rich, yet has nothing; And one who makes himself poor, yet has great riches.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:8: Proverbs 13:8 The ransom of a man's life is his riches, But the poor does not hear rebuke.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:9: Proverbs 13:9 The light of the righteous rejoices,  But the lamp of the wicked will be put out.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:10: Proverbs 13:10 By pride comes nothing but strife, But with the well-advised is wisdom.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:11: Proverbs 13:11 Wealth gained by dishonesty will be diminished, But he who gathers by labor will increase.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:12: Proverbs 13:12 Hope deferred makes the heart sick, But when the desire comes, it is a tree of life.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:13: Proverbs 13:13 He who despises the word will be destroyed, But he who fears the commandment will be rewarded.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:14: Proverbs 13:14 The law of the wise is a fountain of life, To turn one away from the snares of death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:15: Proverbs 13:15 Good understanding gains favor, But the way of the unfaithful is hard.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:16: Proverbs 13:16 Every prudent man acts with knowledge, But a fool lays open his folly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:17: Proverbs 13:17 A wicked messenger falls into trouble, But a faithful ambassador brings health.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:18: Proverbs 13:18 Poverty and shame will come to him who disdains correction, But he who regards a rebuke will be honored.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:19: Proverbs 13:19 A desire accomplished is sweet to the soul, But it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:20: Proverbs 13:20 He who walks with wise men will be wise, But the companion of fools will be destroyed.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:21: Proverbs 13:21 Evil pursues sinners, But to the righteous, good shall be repaid.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:22: Proverbs 13:22 A good man leaves an inheritance to his children's children, But the wealth of the sinner is stored up for the righteous.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:23: Proverbs 13:23 Much food is in the fallow ground of the poor, And for lack of justice there is waste.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:24: Proverbs 13:24 He who spares his rod hates his son, But he who loves him disciplines him promptly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 13:25: Proverbs 13:25 The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul, But the stomach of the wicked shall be in want.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:1: Proverbs 14:1 The wise woman builds her house, But the foolish pulls it down with her hands.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:2: Proverbs 14:2 He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD,  But he who is perverse in his ways despises Him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:3: Proverbs 14:3 In the mouth of a fool is a rod of pride,  But the lips of the wise will preserve them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:4: Proverbs 14:4 Where no oxen are, the trough is clean; But much increase comes by the strength of an ox.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:5: Proverbs 14:5 A faithful witness does not lie, But a false witness will utter lies.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:6: Proverbs 14:6 A scoffer seeks wisdom and does not find it, But knowledge is easy to him who understands.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:7: Proverbs 14:7 Go from the presence of a foolish man, When you do not perceive in him the lips of knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:8: Proverbs 14:8 The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way, But the folly of fools is deceit.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:9: Proverbs 14:9 Fools mock at sin, But among the upright there is favor.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:10: Proverbs 14:10 The heart knows its own bitterness, And a stranger does not share its joy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:11: Proverbs 14:11 The house of the wicked will be overthrown, But the tent of the upright will flourish.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:12: Proverbs 14:12 There is a way that seems right to a man, But its end is the way of death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:13: Proverbs 14:13 Even in laughter the heart may sorrow, And the end of mirth may be grief.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:14: Proverbs 14:14 The backslider in heart will be filled with his own ways, But a good man will be satisfied from above.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:15: Proverbs 14:15 The simple believes every word, But the prudent considers well his steps.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:16: Proverbs 14:16 A wise man fears and departs from evil, But a fool rages and is self-confident.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:17: Proverbs 14:17 A quick-tempered man acts foolishly, And a man of wicked intentions is hated.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:18: Proverbs 14:18 The simple inherit folly, But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:19: Proverbs 14:19 The evil will bow before the good, And the wicked at the gates of the righteous.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:20: Proverbs 14:20 The poor man is hated even by his own neighbor, But the rich has many friends.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:21: Proverbs 14:21 He who despises his neighbor sins;  But he who has mercy on the poor, happy is he.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:22: Proverbs 14:22 Do they not go astray who devise evil? But mercy and truth belong to those who devise good.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:23: Proverbs 14:23 In all labor there is profit, But idle chatter leads only to poverty.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:24: Proverbs 14:24 The crown of the wise is their riches, But the foolishness of fools is folly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:25: Proverbs 14:25 A true witness delivers souls, But a deceitful witness speaks lies.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:26: Proverbs 14:26 In the fear of the LORD there is strong confidence, And His children will have a place of refuge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:27: Proverbs 14:27 The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, To turn one away from the snares of death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:28: Proverbs 14:28 In a multitude of people is a king's honor, But in the lack of people is the downfall of a prince.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:29: Proverbs 14:29 He who is slow to wrath has great understanding, But he who is impulsive exalts folly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:30: Proverbs 14:30 A sound heart is life to the body, But envy is rottenness to the bones.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:31: Proverbs 14:31 He who oppresses the poor reproaches his Maker, But he who honors Him has mercy on the needy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:32: Proverbs 14:32 The wicked is banished in his wickedness, But the righteous has a refuge in his death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:33: Proverbs 14:33 Wisdom rests in the heart of him who has understanding, But what is in the heart of fools is made known.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:34: Proverbs 14:34 Righteousness exalts a nation, But sin is a reproach to any people.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 14:35: Proverbs 14:35 The king's favor is toward a wise servant, But his wrath is against him who causes shame.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:1: Proverbs 15:1 A soft answer turns away wrath, But a harsh word stirs up anger.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:2: Proverbs 15:2 The tongue of the wise uses knowledge rightly,  But the mouth of fools pours forth foolishness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:3: Proverbs 15:3 The eyes of the LORD are in every place, Keeping watch on the evil and the good.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:4: Proverbs 15:4 A wholesome tongue is a tree of life, But perverseness in it breaks the spirit.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:5: Proverbs 15:5 A fool despises his father's instruction,  But he who receives correction is prudent.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:6: Proverbs 15:6 In the house of the righteous there is much treasure, But in the revenue of the wicked is trouble.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:7: Proverbs 15:7 The lips of the wise disperse knowledge, But the heart of the fool does not do so.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:8: Proverbs 15:8 The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, But the prayer of the upright is His delight.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:9: Proverbs 15:9 The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, But He loves him who follows righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:10: Proverbs 15:10 Harsh discipline is for him who forsakes the way, And he who hates correction will die.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:11: Proverbs 15:11 Hell and Destruction are before the LORD; So how much more the hearts of the sons of men.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:12: Proverbs 15:12 A scoffer does not love one who corrects him, Nor will he go to the wise.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:13: Proverbs 15:13 A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance, But by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:14: Proverbs 15:14 The heart of him who has understanding seeks knowledge, But the mouth of fools feeds on foolishness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:15: Proverbs 15:15 All the days of the afflicted are evil,  But he who is of a merry heart has a continual feast.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:16: Proverbs 15:16 Better is a little with the fear of the LORD, Than great treasure with trouble.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:17: Proverbs 15:17 Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, Than a fatted calf with hatred.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:18: Proverbs 15:18 A wrathful man stirs up strife, But he who is slow to anger allays contention.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:19: Proverbs 15:19 The way of the lazy man is like a hedge of thorns, But the way of the upright is a highway.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:20: Proverbs 15:20 A wise son makes a father glad, But a foolish man despises his mother.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:21: Proverbs 15:21 Folly is joy to him who is destitute of discernment,  But a man of understanding walks uprightly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:22: Proverbs 15:22 Without counsel, plans go awry, But in the multitude of counselors they are established.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:23: Proverbs 15:23 A man has joy by the answer of his mouth, And a word spoken in due season, how good it is!(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:24: Proverbs 15:24 The way of life winds upward for the wise, That he may turn away from hell below.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:25: Proverbs 15:25 The LORD will destroy the house of the proud, But He will establish the boundary of the widow.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:26: Proverbs 15:26 The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD,  But the words of the pure are pleasant.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:27: Proverbs 15:27 He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, But he who hates bribes will live.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:28: Proverbs 15:28 The heart of the righteous studies how to answer, But the mouth of the wicked pours forth evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:29: Proverbs 15:29 The LORD is far from the wicked, But He hears the prayer of the righteous.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:30: Proverbs 15:30 The light of the eyes rejoices the heart, And a good report makes the bones healthy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:31: Proverbs 15:31 The ear that hears the rebukes of life Will abide among the wise.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:32: Proverbs 15:32 He who disdains instruction despises his own soul, But he who heeds rebuke gets understanding.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 15:33: Proverbs 15:33 The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom, And before honor is humility.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:1: Proverbs 16:1 The preparations of the heart belong to man,  But the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:2: Proverbs 16:2 All the ways of a man are pure in his own eyes, But the LORD weighs the spirits.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:3: Proverbs 16:3 Commit your works to the LORD, And your thoughts will be established.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:4: Proverbs 16:4 The LORD has made all for Himself,  Yes, even the wicked for the day of doom.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:5: Proverbs 16:5 Everyone proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; Though they join forces, none will go unpunished.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:6: Proverbs 16:6 In mercy and truth Atonement is provided for iniquity; And by the fear of the LORD one departs from evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:7: Proverbs 16:7 When a man's ways please the LORD, He makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:8: Proverbs 16:8 Better is a little with righteousness, Than vast revenues without justice.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:9: Proverbs 16:9 A man's heart plans his way,  But the LORD directs his steps.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:10: Proverbs 16:10 Divination is on the lips of the king; His mouth must not transgress in judgment.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:11: Proverbs 16:11 Honest weights and scales are the LORD's; All the weights in the bag are His work.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:12: Proverbs 16:12 It is an abomination for kings to commit wickedness, For a throne is established by righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:13: Proverbs 16:13 Righteous lips are the delight of kings, And they love him who speaks what is right.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:14: Proverbs 16:14 As messengers of death is the king's wrath, But a wise man will appease it.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:15: Proverbs 16:15 In the light of the king's face is life, And his favor is like a cloud of the latter rain.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:16: Proverbs 16:16 How much better to get wisdom than gold! And to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:17: Proverbs 16:17 The highway of the upright is to depart from evil; He who keeps his way preserves his soul.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:18: Proverbs 16:18 Pride goes before destruction, And a haughty spirit before a fall.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:19: Proverbs 16:19 Better to be of a humble spirit with the lowly, Than to divide the spoil with the proud.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:20: Proverbs 16:20 He who heeds the word wisely will find good, And whoever trusts in the LORD, happy is he.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:21: Proverbs 16:21 The wise in heart will be called prudent, And sweetness of the lips increases learning.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:22: Proverbs 16:22 Understanding is a wellspring of life to him who has it. But the correction of fools is folly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:23: Proverbs 16:23 The heart of the wise teaches his mouth, And adds learning to his lips.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:24: Proverbs 16:24 Pleasant words are like a honeycomb, Sweetness to the soul and health to the bones.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:25: Proverbs 16:25 There is a way that seems right to a man, But its end is the way of death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:26: Proverbs 16:26 The person who labors, labors for himself, For his hungry mouth drives him on.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:27: Proverbs 16:27 An ungodly man digs up evil, And it is on his lips like a burning fire.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:28: Proverbs 16:28 A perverse man sows strife, And a whisperer separates the best of friends.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:29: Proverbs 16:29 A violent man entices his neighbor, And leads him in a way that is not good.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:30: Proverbs 16:30 He winks his eye to devise perverse things; He purses his lips and brings about evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:31: Proverbs 16:31 The silver-haired head is a crown of glory, If it is found in the way of righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:32: Proverbs 16:32 He who is slow to anger is better than the mighty, And he who rules his spirit than he who takes a city.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 16:33: Proverbs 16:33 The lot is cast into the lap, But its every decision is from the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:1: Proverbs 17:1 Better is a dry morsel with quietness, Than a house full of feasting with strife.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:2: Proverbs 17:2 A wise servant will rule over a son who causes shame, And will share an inheritance among the brothers.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:3: Proverbs 17:3 The refining pot is for silver and the furnace for gold,  But the LORD tests the hearts.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:4: Proverbs 17:4 An evildoer gives heed to false lips; A liar listens eagerly to a spiteful tongue.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:5: Proverbs 17:5 He who mocks the poor reproaches his Maker;  He who is glad at calamity will not go unpunished.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:6: Proverbs 17:6 Children's children are the crown of old men, And the glory of children is their father.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:7: Proverbs 17:7 Excellent speech is not becoming to a fool, Much less lying lips to a prince.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:8: Proverbs 17:8 A present is a precious stone in the eyes of its possessor; Wherever he turns, he prospers.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:9: Proverbs 17:9 He who covers a transgression seeks love, But he who repeats a matter separates friends.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:10: Proverbs 17:10 Rebuke is more effective for a wise man Than a hundred blows on a fool.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:11: Proverbs 17:11 An evil man seeks only rebellion; Therefore a cruel messenger will be sent against him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:12: Proverbs 17:12 Let a man meet a bear robbed of her cubs, Rather than a fool in his folly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:13: Proverbs 17:13 Whoever rewards evil for good, Evil will not depart from his house.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:14: Proverbs 17:14 The beginning of strife is like releasing water; Therefore stop contention before a quarrel starts.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:15: Proverbs 17:15 He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the just, Both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:16: Proverbs 17:16 Why is there in the hand of a fool the purchase price of wisdom, Since he has no heart for it?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:17: Proverbs 17:17 A friend loves at all times, And a brother is born for adversity.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:18: Proverbs 17:18 A man devoid of understanding shakes hands in a pledge, And becomes surety for his friend.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:19: Proverbs 17:19 He who loves transgression loves strife, And he who exalts his gate seeks destruction.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:20: Proverbs 17:20 He who has a deceitful heart finds no good, And he who has a perverse tongue falls into evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:21: Proverbs 17:21 He who begets a scoffer does so to his sorrow, And the father of a fool has no joy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:22: Proverbs 17:22 A merry heart does good, like medicine, But a broken spirit dries the bones.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:23: Proverbs 17:23 A wicked man accepts a bribe behind the back To pervert the ways of justice.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:24: Proverbs 17:24 Wisdom is in the sight of him who has understanding, But the eyes of a fool are on the ends of the earth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:25: Proverbs 17:25 A foolish son is a grief to his father, And bitterness to her who bore him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:26: Proverbs 17:26 Also, to punish the righteous is not good, Nor to strike princes for their uprightness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:27: Proverbs 17:27 He who has knowledge spares his words, And a man of understanding is of a calm spirit.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 17:28: Proverbs 17:28 Even a fool is counted wise when he holds his peace; When he shuts his lips, he is considered perceptive.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:1: Proverbs 18:1 A man who isolates himself seeks his own desire; He rages against all wise judgment.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:2: Proverbs 18:2 A fool has no delight in understanding, But in expressing his own heart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:3: Proverbs 18:3 When the wicked comes, contempt comes also; And with dishonor comes reproach.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:4: Proverbs 18:4 The words of a man's mouth are deep waters;  The wellspring of wisdom is a flowing brook.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:5: Proverbs 18:5 It is not good to show partiality to the wicked, Or to overthrow the righteous in judgment.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:6: Proverbs 18:6 A fool's lips enter into contention, And his mouth calls for blows.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:7: Proverbs 18:7 A fool's mouth is his destruction, And his lips are the snare of his soul.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:8: Proverbs 18:8 The words of a talebearer are like tasty trifles, And they go down into the inmost body.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:9: Proverbs 18:9 He who is slothful in his work Is a brother to him who is a great destroyer.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:10: Proverbs 18:10 The name of the LORD is a strong tower; The righteous run to it and are safe.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:11: Proverbs 18:11 The rich man's wealth is his strong city, And like a high wall in his own esteem.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:12: Proverbs 18:12 Before destruction the heart of a man is haughty, And before honor is humility.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:13: Proverbs 18:13 He who answers a matter before he hears it, It is folly and shame to him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:14: Proverbs 18:14 The spirit of a man will sustain him in sickness, But who can bear a broken spirit?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:15: Proverbs 18:15 The heart of the prudent acquires knowledge, And the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:16: Proverbs 18:16 A man's gift makes room for him, And brings him before great men.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:17: Proverbs 18:17 The first one to plead his cause seems right, Until his neighbor comes and examines him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:18: Proverbs 18:18 Casting lots causes contentions to cease, And keeps the mighty apart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:19: Proverbs 18:19 A brother offended is harder to win than a strong city, And contentions are like the bars of a castle.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:20: Proverbs 18:20 A man's stomach shall be satisfied from the fruit of his mouth; From the produce of his lips he shall be filled.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:21: Proverbs 18:21 Death and life are in the power of the tongue, And those who love it will eat its fruit.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:22: Proverbs 18:22 He who finds a wife finds a good thing, And obtains favor from the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:23: Proverbs 18:23 The poor man uses entreaties, But the rich answers roughly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 18:24: Proverbs 18:24 A man who has friends must himself be friendly,  But there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:1: Proverbs 19:1 Better is the poor who walks in his integrity Than one who is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:2: Proverbs 19:2 Also it is not good for a soul to be without knowledge, And he sins who hastens with his feet.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:3: Proverbs 19:3 The foolishness of a man twists his way, And his heart frets against the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:4: Proverbs 19:4 Wealth makes many friends, But the poor is separated from his friend.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:5: Proverbs 19:5 A false witness will not go unpunished, And he who speaks lies will not escape.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:6: Proverbs 19:6 Many entreat the favor of the nobility, And every man is a friend to one who gives gifts.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:7: Proverbs 19:7 All the brothers of the poor hate him; How much more do his friends go far from him! He may pursue them with words, yet they abandon him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:8: Proverbs 19:8 He who gets wisdom loves his own soul; He who keeps understanding will find good.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:9: Proverbs 19:9 A false witness will not go unpunished, And he who speaks lies shall perish.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:10: Proverbs 19:10 Luxury is not fitting for a fool, Much less for a servant to rule over princes.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:11: Proverbs 19:11 The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger,  And his glory is to overlook a transgression.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:12: Proverbs 19:12 The king's wrath is like the roaring of a lion, But his favor is like dew on the grass.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:13: Proverbs 19:13 A foolish son is the ruin of his father,  And the contentions of a wife are a continual dripping.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:14: Proverbs 19:14 Houses and riches are an inheritance from fathers, But a prudent wife is from the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:15: Proverbs 19:15 Laziness casts one into a deep sleep, And an idle person will suffer hunger.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:16: Proverbs 19:16 He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, But he who is careless of his ways will die.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:17: Proverbs 19:17 He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD, And He will pay back what he has given.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:18: Proverbs 19:18 Chasten your son while there is hope, And do not set your heart on his destruction.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:19: Proverbs 19:19 A man of great wrath will suffer punishment; For if you rescue him, you will have to do it again.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:20: Proverbs 19:20 Listen to counsel and receive instruction, That you may be wise in your latter days.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:21: Proverbs 19:21 There are many plans in a man's heart,  Nevertheless the LORD's counsel"”that will stand.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:22: Proverbs 19:22 What is desired in a man is kindness, And a poor man is better than a liar.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:23: Proverbs 19:23 The fear of the LORD leads to life, And he who has it will abide in satisfaction; He will not be visited with evil.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:24: Proverbs 19:24 A lazy man buries his hand in the bowl, And will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:25: Proverbs 19:25 Strike a scoffer, and the simple will become wary;  Rebuke one who has understanding, and he will discern knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:26: Proverbs 19:26 He who mistreats his father and chases away his mother Is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:27: Proverbs 19:27 Cease listening to instruction, my son, And you will stray from the words of knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:28: Proverbs 19:28 A disreputable witness scorns justice, And the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 19:29: Proverbs 19:29 Judgments are prepared for scoffers,  And beatings for the backs of fools.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:1: Proverbs 20:1 Wine is a mocker, Strong drink is a brawler, And whoever is led astray by it is not wise.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:2: Proverbs 20:2 The wrath of a king is like the roaring of a lion; Whoever provokes him to anger sins against his own life.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:3: Proverbs 20:3 It is honorable for a man to stop striving, Since any fool can start a quarrel.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:4: Proverbs 20:4 The lazy man will not plow because of winter;  He will beg during harvest and have nothing.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:5: Proverbs 20:5 Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, But a man of understanding will draw it out.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:6: Proverbs 20:6 Most men will proclaim each his own goodness, But who can find a faithful man?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:7: Proverbs 20:7 The righteous man walks in his integrity;  His children are blessed after him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:8: Proverbs 20:8 A king who sits on the throne of judgment Scatters all evil with his eyes.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:9: Proverbs 20:9 Who can say, "I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin"?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:10: Proverbs 20:10 Diverse weights and diverse measures, They are both alike, an abomination to the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:11: Proverbs 20:11 Even a child is known by his deeds, Whether what he does is pure and right.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:12: Proverbs 20:12 The hearing ear and the seeing eye, The LORD has made them both.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:13: Proverbs 20:13 Do not love sleep, lest you come to poverty; Open your eyes, and you will be satisfied with bread.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:14: Proverbs 20:14 "It is good for nothing," cries the buyer; But when he has gone his way, then he boasts.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:15: Proverbs 20:15 There is gold and a multitude of rubies, But the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:16: Proverbs 20:16 Take the garment of one who is surety for a stranger, And hold it as a pledge when it is for a seductress.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:17: Proverbs 20:17 Bread gained by deceit is sweet to a man, But afterward his mouth will be filled with gravel.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:18: Proverbs 20:18 Plans are established by counsel;  By wise counsel wage war.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:19: Proverbs 20:19 He who goes about as a talebearer reveals secrets; Therefore do not associate with one who flatters with his lips.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:20: Proverbs 20:20 Whoever curses his father or his mother,  His lamp will be put out in deep darkness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:21: Proverbs 20:21 An inheritance gained hastily at the beginning  Will not be blessed at the end.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:22: Proverbs 20:22 Do not say, "I will recompense evil";  Wait for the LORD, and He will save you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:23: Proverbs 20:23 Diverse weights are an abomination to the LORD, And dishonest scales are not good.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:24: Proverbs 20:24 A man's steps are of the LORD; How then can a man understand his own way?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:25: Proverbs 20:25 It is a snare for a man to devote rashly something as holy, And afterward to reconsider his vows.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:26: Proverbs 20:26 A wise king sifts out the wicked, And brings the threshing wheel over them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:27: Proverbs 20:27 The spirit of a man is the lamp of the LORD, Searching all the inner depths of his heart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:28: Proverbs 20:28 Mercy and truth preserve the king, And by lovingkindness he upholds his throne.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:29: Proverbs 20:29 The glory of young men is their strength, And the splendor of old men is their gray head.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 20:30: Proverbs 20:30 Blows that hurt cleanse away evil, As do stripes the inner depths of the heart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:1: Proverbs 21:1 The king's heart is in the hand of the LORD, Like the rivers of water; He turns it wherever He wishes.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:2: Proverbs 21:2 Every way of a man is right in his own eyes,  But the LORD weighs the hearts.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:3: Proverbs 21:3 To do righteousness and justice Is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:4: Proverbs 21:4 A haughty look, a proud heart, And the plowing of the wicked are sin.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:5: Proverbs 21:5 The plans of the diligent lead surely to plenty, But those of everyone who is hasty, surely to poverty.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:6: Proverbs 21:6 Getting treasures by a lying tongue Is the fleeting fantasy of those who seek death.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:7: Proverbs 21:7 The violence of the wicked will destroy them, Because they refuse to do justice.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:8: Proverbs 21:8 The way of a guilty man is perverse; But as for the pure, his work is right.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:9: Proverbs 21:9 Better to dwell in a corner of a housetop, Than in a house shared with a contentious woman.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:10: Proverbs 21:10 The soul of the wicked desires evil; His neighbor finds no favor in his eyes.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:11: Proverbs 21:11 When the scoffer is punished, the simple is made wise; But when the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:12: Proverbs 21:12 The righteous God wisely considers the house of the wicked, Overthrowing the wicked for their wickedness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:13: Proverbs 21:13 Whoever shuts his ears to the cry of the poor Will also cry himself and not be heard.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:14: Proverbs 21:14 A gift in secret pacifies anger, And a bribe behind the back, strong wrath.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:15: Proverbs 21:15 It is a joy for the just to do justice, But destruction will come to the workers of iniquity.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:16: Proverbs 21:16 A man who wanders from the way of understanding Will rest in the assembly of the dead.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:17: Proverbs 21:17 He who loves pleasure will be a poor man; He who loves wine and oil will not be rich.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:18: Proverbs 21:18 The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, And the unfaithful for the upright.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:19: Proverbs 21:19 Better to dwell in the wilderness, Than with a contentious and angry woman.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:20: Proverbs 21:20 There is desirable treasure, And oil in the dwelling of the wise, But a foolish man squanders it.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:21: Proverbs 21:21 He who follows righteousness and mercy Finds life, righteousness, and honor.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:22: Proverbs 21:22 A wise man scales the city of the mighty, And brings down the trusted stronghold.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:23: Proverbs 21:23 Whoever guards his mouth and tongue Keeps his soul from troubles.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:24: Proverbs 21:24 A proud and haughty man"” "Scoffer" is his name; He acts with arrogant pride.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:25: Proverbs 21:25 The desire of the lazy man kills him, For his hands refuse to labor.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:26: Proverbs 21:26 He covets greedily all day long, But the righteous gives and does not spare.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:27: Proverbs 21:27 The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination; How much more when he brings it with wicked intent!(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:28: Proverbs 21:28 A false witness shall perish, But the man who hears him will speak endlessly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:29: Proverbs 21:29 A wicked man hardens his face, But as for the upright, he establishes his way.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:30: Proverbs 21:30 There is no wisdom or understanding Or counsel against the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 21:31: Proverbs 21:31 The horse is prepared for the day of battle, But deliverance is of the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:1: Proverbs 22:1 A good name is to be chosen rather than great riches, Loving favor rather than silver and gold.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:2: Proverbs 22:2 The rich and the poor have this in common, The LORD is the maker of them all.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:3: Proverbs 22:3 A prudent man foresees evil and hides himself, But the simple pass on and are punished.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:4: Proverbs 22:4 By humility and the fear of the LORD Are riches and honor and life.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:5: Proverbs 22:5 Thorns and snares are in the way of the perverse; He who guards his soul will be far from them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:6: Proverbs 22:6 Train up a child in the way he should go, And when he is old he will not depart from it.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:7: Proverbs 22:7 The rich rules over the poor, And the borrower is servant to the lender.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:8: Proverbs 22:8 He who sows iniquity will reap sorrow, And the rod of his anger will fail.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:9: Proverbs 22:9 He who has a generous eye will be blessed, For he gives of his bread to the poor.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:10: Proverbs 22:10 Cast out the scoffer, and contention will leave; Yes, strife and reproach will cease.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:11: Proverbs 22:11 He who loves purity of heart And has grace on his lips, The king will be his friend.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:12: Proverbs 22:12 The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, But He overthrows the words of the faithless.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:13: Proverbs 22:13 The lazy man says, "There is a lion outside! I shall be slain in the streets!"(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:14: Proverbs 22:14 The mouth of an immoral woman is a deep pit;  He who is abhorred by the LORD will fall there.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:15: Proverbs 22:15 Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child;  The rod of correction will drive it far from him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:16: Proverbs 22:16 He who oppresses the poor to increase his riches, And he who gives to the rich, will surely come to poverty.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:17: Proverbs 22:17 Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise, And apply your heart to my knowledge;(NKJV)
