verses.proverbs 22:18: Proverbs 22:18 For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you; Let them all be fixed upon your lips,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:19: Proverbs 22:19 So that your trust may be in the LORD; I have instructed you today, even you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:20: Proverbs 22:20 Have I not written to you excellent things Of counsels and knowledge,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:21: Proverbs 22:21 That I may make you know the certainty of the words of truth,  That you may answer words of truth To those who send to you?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:22: Proverbs 22:22 Do not rob the poor because he is poor, Nor oppress the afflicted at the gate;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:23: Proverbs 22:23 For the LORD will plead their cause, And plunder the soul of those who plunder them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:24: Proverbs 22:24 Make no friendship with an angry man, And with a furious man do not go,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:25: Proverbs 22:25 Lest you learn his ways And set a snare for your soul.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:26: Proverbs 22:26 Do not be one of those who shakes hands in a pledge, One of those who is surety for debts;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:27: Proverbs 22:27 If you have nothing with which to pay, Why should he take away your bed from under you?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:28: Proverbs 22:28 Do not remove the ancient landmark Which your fathers have set.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 22:29: Proverbs 22:29 Do you see a man who excels in his work? He will stand before kings; He will not stand before unknown men.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:1: Proverbs 23:1 When you sit down to eat with a ruler, Consider carefully what is before you;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:2: Proverbs 23:2 And put a knife to your throat If you are a man given to appetite.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:3: Proverbs 23:3 Do not desire his delicacies, For they are deceptive food.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:4: Proverbs 23:4 Do not overwork to be rich;  Because of your own understanding, cease!(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:5: Proverbs 23:5 Will you set your eyes on that which is not? For riches certainly make themselves wings; They fly away like an eagle toward heaven.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:6: Proverbs 23:6 Do not eat the bread of a miser, Nor desire his delicacies;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:7: Proverbs 23:7 For as he thinks in his heart, so is he. "Eat and drink!" he says to you, But his heart is not with you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:8: Proverbs 23:8 The morsel you have eaten, you will vomit up, And waste your pleasant words.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:9: Proverbs 23:9 Do not speak in the hearing of a fool, For he will despise the wisdom of your words.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:10: Proverbs 23:10 Do not remove the ancient landmark, Nor enter the fields of the fatherless;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:11: Proverbs 23:11 For their Redeemer is mighty; He will plead their cause against you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:12: Proverbs 23:12 Apply your heart to instruction, And your ears to words of knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:13: Proverbs 23:13 Do not withhold correction from a child, For if you beat him with a rod, he will not die.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:14: Proverbs 23:14 You shall beat him with a rod, And deliver his soul from hell.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:15: Proverbs 23:15 My son, if your heart is wise, My heart will rejoice"”indeed, I myself;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:16: Proverbs 23:16 Yes, my inmost being will rejoice When your lips speak right things.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:17: Proverbs 23:17 Do not let your heart envy sinners, But be zealous for the fear of the LORD all the day;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:18: Proverbs 23:18 For surely there is a hereafter, And your hope will not be cut off.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:19: Proverbs 23:19 Hear, my son, and be wise; And guide your heart in the way.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:20: Proverbs 23:20 Do not mix with winebibbers, Or with gluttonous eaters of meat;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:21: Proverbs 23:21 For the drunkard and the glutton will come to poverty, And drowsiness will clothe a man with rags.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:22: Proverbs 23:22 Listen to your father who begot you, And do not despise your mother when she is old.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:23: Proverbs 23:23 Buy the truth, and do not sell it, Also wisdom and instruction and understanding.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:24: Proverbs 23:24 The father of the righteous will greatly rejoice, And he who begets a wise child will delight in him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:25: Proverbs 23:25 Let your father and your mother be glad, And let her who bore you rejoice.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:26: Proverbs 23:26 My son, give me your heart, And let your eyes observe my ways.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:27: Proverbs 23:27 For a harlot is a deep pit, And a seductress is a narrow well.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:28: Proverbs 23:28 She also lies in wait as for a victim, And increases the unfaithful among men.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:29: Proverbs 23:29 Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has contentions? Who has complaints? Who has wounds without cause? Who has redness of eyes?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:30: Proverbs 23:30 Those who linger long at the wine, Those who go in search of mixed wine.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:31: Proverbs 23:31 Do not look on the wine when it is red, When it sparkles in the cup, When it swirls around smoothly;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:32: Proverbs 23:32 At the last it bites like a serpent, And stings like a viper.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:33: Proverbs 23:33 Your eyes will see strange things, And your heart will utter perverse things.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:34: Proverbs 23:34 Yes, you will be like one who lies down in the midst of the sea, Or like one who lies at the top of the mast, saying:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 23:35: Proverbs 23:35 "They  have struck me, but I was not hurt; They have beaten me, but I did not feel it. When shall I awake, that I may seek another drink?"(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:1: Proverbs 24:1 Do not be envious of evil men, Nor desire to be with them;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:2: Proverbs 24:2 For their heart devises violence, And their lips talk of troublemaking.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:3: Proverbs 24:3 Through wisdom a house is built, And by understanding it is established;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:4: Proverbs 24:4 By knowledge the rooms are filled With all precious and pleasant riches.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:5: Proverbs 24:5 A wise man is strong, Yes, a man of knowledge increases strength;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:6: Proverbs 24:6 For by wise counsel you will wage your own war, And in a multitude of counselors there is safety.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:7: Proverbs 24:7 Wisdom is too lofty for a fool; He does not open his mouth in the gate.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:8: Proverbs 24:8 He who plots to do evil Will be called a schemer.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:9: Proverbs 24:9 The devising of foolishness is sin, And the scoffer is an abomination to men.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:10: Proverbs 24:10 If you faint in the day of adversity, Your strength is small.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:11: Proverbs 24:11 Deliver those who are drawn toward death, And hold back those stumbling to the slaughter.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:12: Proverbs 24:12 If you say, "Surely we did not know this," Does not He who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, does He not know it? And will He not render to each man according to his deeds?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:13: Proverbs 24:13 My son, eat honey because it is good, And the honeycomb which is sweet to your taste;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:14: Proverbs 24:14 So shall the knowledge of wisdom be to your soul; If you have found it, there is a prospect, And your hope will not be cut off.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:15: Proverbs 24:15 Do not lie in wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; Do not plunder his resting place;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:16: Proverbs 24:16 For a righteous man may fall seven times And rise again,  But the wicked shall fall by calamity.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:17: Proverbs 24:17 Do not rejoice when your enemy falls, And do not let your heart be glad when he stumbles;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:18: Proverbs 24:18 Lest the LORD see it, and it displease Him, And He turn away His wrath from him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:19: Proverbs 24:19 Do not fret because of evildoers, Nor be envious of the wicked;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:20: Proverbs 24:20 For there will be no prospect for the evil man; The lamp of the wicked will be put out.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:21: Proverbs 24:21 My son, fear the LORD and the king; Do not associate with those given to change;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:22: Proverbs 24:22 For their calamity will rise suddenly, And who knows the ruin those two can bring?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:23: Proverbs 24:23 These things also belong to the wise:  It is not good to show partiality in judgment.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:24: Proverbs 24:24 He who says to the wicked, "You are righteous," Him the people will curse; Nations will abhor him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:25: Proverbs 24:25 But those who rebuke the wicked will have delight, And a good blessing will come upon them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:26: Proverbs 24:26 He who gives a right answer kisses the lips.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:27: Proverbs 24:27 Prepare your outside work, Make it fit for yourself in the field; And afterward build your house.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:28: Proverbs 24:28 Do not be a witness against your neighbor without cause, For would you deceive with your lips?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:29: Proverbs 24:29 Do not say, "I will do to him just as he has done to me; I will render to the man according to his work."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:30: Proverbs 24:30 I went by the field of the lazy man, And by the vineyard of the man devoid of understanding;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:31: Proverbs 24:31 And there it was, all overgrown with thorns; Its surface was covered with nettles; Its stone wall was broken down.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:32: Proverbs 24:32 When I saw it, I considered it well; I looked on it and received instruction:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:33: Proverbs 24:33 A little sleep, a little slumber, A little folding of the hands to rest;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 24:34: Proverbs 24:34 So shall your poverty come like a prowler, And your need like an armed man.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:1: Proverbs 25:1 These  also are proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:2: Proverbs 25:2 It is the glory of God to conceal a matter, But the glory of kings is to search out a matter.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:3: Proverbs 25:3 As the heavens for height and the earth for depth, So the heart of kings is unsearchable.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:4: Proverbs 25:4 Take away the dross from silver, And it will go to the silversmith for jewelry.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:5: Proverbs 25:5 Take away the wicked from before the king, And his throne will be established in righteousness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:6: Proverbs 25:6 Do not exalt yourself in the presence of the king, And do not stand in the place of the great;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:7: Proverbs 25:7 For it is better that he say to you, "Come up here," Than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, Whom your eyes have seen.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:8: Proverbs 25:8 Do not go hastily to court; For what will you do in the end, When your neighbor has put you to shame?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:9: Proverbs 25:9 Debate your case with your neighbor, And do not disclose the secret to another;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:10: Proverbs 25:10 Lest he who hears it expose your shame, And your reputation be ruined.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:11: Proverbs 25:11 A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold In settings of silver.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:12: Proverbs 25:12 Like an earring of gold and an ornament of fine gold Is a wise rebuker to an obedient ear.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:13: Proverbs 25:13 Like the cold of snow in time of harvest Is a faithful messenger to those who send him, For he refreshes the soul of his masters.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:14: Proverbs 25:14 Whoever falsely boasts of giving Is like clouds and wind without rain.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:15: Proverbs 25:15 By long forbearance a ruler is persuaded, And a gentle tongue breaks a bone.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:16: Proverbs 25:16 Have you found honey? Eat only as much as you need, Lest you be filled with it and vomit.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:17: Proverbs 25:17 Seldom set foot in your neighbor's house, Lest he become weary of you and hate you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:18: Proverbs 25:18 A man who bears false witness against his neighbor Is like a club, a sword, and a sharp arrow.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:19: Proverbs 25:19 Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble Is like a bad tooth and a foot out of joint.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:20: Proverbs 25:20 Like one who takes away a garment in cold weather, And like vinegar on soda, Is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:21: Proverbs 25:21 If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat; And if he is thirsty, give him water to drink;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:22: Proverbs 25:22 For so you will heap coals of fire on his head,  And the LORD will reward you.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:23: Proverbs 25:23 The north wind brings forth rain, And a backbiting tongue an angry countenance.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:24: Proverbs 25:24 It is better to dwell in a corner of a housetop, Than in a house shared with a contentious woman.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:25: Proverbs 25:25 As cold water to a weary soul, So is good news from a far country.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:26: Proverbs 25:26 A righteous man who falters before the wicked Is like a murky spring and a polluted well.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:27: Proverbs 25:27 It is not good to eat much honey; So to seek one's own glory is not glory.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 25:28: Proverbs 25:28 Whoever has no rule over his own spirit Is like a city broken down, without walls.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:1: Proverbs 26:1 As snow in summer and rain in harvest, So honor is not fitting for a fool.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:2: Proverbs 26:2 Like a flitting sparrow, like a flying swallow, So a curse without cause shall not alight.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:3: Proverbs 26:3 A whip for the horse, A bridle for the donkey, And a rod for the fool's back.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:4: Proverbs 26:4 Do not answer a fool according to his folly, Lest you also be like him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:5: Proverbs 26:5 Answer a fool according to his folly, Lest he be wise in his own eyes.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:6: Proverbs 26:6 He who sends a message by the hand of a fool Cuts off his own feet and drinks violence.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:7: Proverbs 26:7 Like the legs of the lame that hang limp Is a proverb in the mouth of fools.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:8: Proverbs 26:8 Like one who binds a stone in a sling Is he who gives honor to a fool.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:9: Proverbs 26:9 Like a thorn that goes into the hand of a drunkard Is a proverb in the mouth of fools.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:10: Proverbs 26:10 The great God who formed everything Gives the fool his hire and the transgressor his wages.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:11: Proverbs 26:11 As a dog returns to his own vomit,  So a fool repeats his folly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:12: Proverbs 26:12 Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:13: Proverbs 26:13 The lazy man says, "There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion is in the streets!"(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:14: Proverbs 26:14 As a door turns on its hinges, So does the lazy man on his bed.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:15: Proverbs 26:15 The lazy man buries his hand in the bowl; It wearies him to bring it back to his mouth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:16: Proverbs 26:16 The lazy man is wiser in his own eyes Than seven men who can answer sensibly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:17: Proverbs 26:17 He who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own Is like one who takes a dog by the ears.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:18: Proverbs 26:18 Like a madman who throws firebrands, arrows, and death,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:19: Proverbs 26:19 Is the man who deceives his neighbor, And says, "I was only joking!"(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:20: Proverbs 26:20 Where there is no wood, the fire goes out; And where there is no talebearer, strife ceases.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:21: Proverbs 26:21 As charcoal is to burning coals, and wood to fire, So is a contentious man to kindle strife.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:22: Proverbs 26:22 The words of a talebearer are like tasty trifles, And they go down into the inmost body.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:23: Proverbs 26:23 Fervent lips with a wicked heart Are like earthenware covered with silver dross.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:24: Proverbs 26:24 He who hates, disguises it with his lips, And lays up deceit within himself;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:25: Proverbs 26:25 When he speaks kindly, do not believe him, For there are seven abominations in his heart;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:26: Proverbs 26:26 Though his hatred is covered by deceit, His wickedness will be revealed before the assembly.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:27: Proverbs 26:27 Whoever digs a pit will fall into it, And he who rolls a stone will have it roll back on him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 26:28: Proverbs 26:28 A lying tongue hates those who are crushed by it, And a flattering mouth works ruin.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:1: Proverbs 27:1 Do  not boast about tomorrow, For you do not know what a day may bring forth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:2: Proverbs 27:2 Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; A stranger, and not your own lips.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:3: Proverbs 27:3 A stone is heavy and sand is weighty, But a fool's wrath is heavier than both of them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:4: Proverbs 27:4 Wrath is cruel and anger a torrent, But who is able to stand before jealousy?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:5: Proverbs 27:5 Open rebuke is better Than love carefully concealed.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:6: Proverbs 27:6 Faithful are the wounds of a friend, But the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:7: Proverbs 27:7 A satisfied soul loathes the honeycomb, But to a hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:8: Proverbs 27:8 Like a bird that wanders from its nest Is a man who wanders from his place.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:9: Proverbs 27:9 Ointment and perfume delight the heart, And the sweetness of a man's friend gives delight by hearty counsel.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:10: Proverbs 27:10 Do not forsake your own friend or your father's friend, Nor go to your brother's house in the day of your calamity;  Better is a neighbor nearby than a brother far away.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:11: Proverbs 27:11 My son, be wise, and make my heart glad,  That I may answer him who reproaches me.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:12: Proverbs 27:12 A prudent man foresees evil and hides himself; The simple pass on and are punished.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:13: Proverbs 27:13 Take the garment of him who is surety for a stranger, And hold it in pledge when he is surety for a seductress.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:14: Proverbs 27:14 He who blesses his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, It will be counted a curse to him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:15: Proverbs 27:15 A continual dripping on a very rainy day And a contentious woman are alike;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:16: Proverbs 27:16 Whoever restrains her restrains the wind, And grasps oil with his right hand.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:17: Proverbs 27:17 As iron sharpens iron, So a man sharpens the countenance of his friend.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:18: Proverbs 27:18 Whoever keeps the fig tree will eat its fruit; So he who waits on his master will be honored.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:19: Proverbs 27:19 As in water face reflects face, So a man's heart reveals the man.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:20: Proverbs 27:20 Hell and Destruction are never full; So the eyes of man are never satisfied.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:21: Proverbs 27:21 The refining pot is for silver and the furnace for gold, And a man is valued by what others say of him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:22: Proverbs 27:22 Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with crushed grain, Yet his foolishness will not depart from him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:23: Proverbs 27:23 Be diligent to know the state of your flocks, And attend to your herds;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:24: Proverbs 27:24 For riches are not forever, Nor does a crown endure to all generations.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:25: Proverbs 27:25 When the hay is removed, and the tender grass shows itself, And the herbs of the mountains are gathered in,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:26: Proverbs 27:26 The lambs will provide your clothing, And the goats the price of a field;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 27:27: Proverbs 27:27 You shall have enough goats' milk for your food, For the food of your household, And the nourishment of your maidservants.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:1: Proverbs 28:1 The wicked flee when no one pursues, But the righteous are bold as a lion.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:2: Proverbs 28:2 Because of the transgression of a land, many are its princes; But by a man of understanding and knowledge Right will be prolonged.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:3: Proverbs 28:3 A poor man who oppresses the poor Is like a driving rain which leaves no food.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:4: Proverbs 28:4 Those who forsake the law praise the wicked,  But such as keep the law contend with them.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:5: Proverbs 28:5 Evil men do not understand justice, But those who seek the LORD understand all.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:6: Proverbs 28:6 Better is the poor who walks in his integrity Than one perverse in his ways, though he be rich.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:7: Proverbs 28:7 Whoever keeps the law is a discerning son, But a companion of gluttons shames his father.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:8: Proverbs 28:8 One who increases his possessions by usury and extortion Gathers it for him who will pity the poor.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:9: Proverbs 28:9 One who turns away his ear from hearing the law,  Even his prayer is an abomination.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:10: Proverbs 28:10 Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, He himself will fall into his own pit;  But the blameless will inherit good.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:11: Proverbs 28:11 The rich man is wise in his own eyes, But the poor who has understanding searches him out.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:12: Proverbs 28:12 When the righteous rejoice, there is great glory; But when the wicked arise, men hide themselves.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:13: Proverbs 28:13 He who covers his sins will not prosper, But whoever confesses and forsakes them will have mercy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:14: Proverbs 28:14 Happy is the man who is always reverent, But he who hardens his heart will fall into calamity.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:15: Proverbs 28:15 Like a roaring lion and a charging bear  Is a wicked ruler over poor people.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:16: Proverbs 28:16 A ruler who lacks understanding is a great oppressor, But he who hates covetousness will prolong his days.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:17: Proverbs 28:17 A man burdened with bloodshed will flee into a pit; Let no one help him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:18: Proverbs 28:18 Whoever walks blamelessly will be saved, But he who is perverse in his ways will suddenly fall.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:19: Proverbs 28:19 He who tills his land will have plenty of bread, But he who follows frivolity will have poverty enough!(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:20: Proverbs 28:20 A faithful man will abound with blessings,  But he who hastens to be rich will not go unpunished.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:21: Proverbs 28:21 To show partiality is not good,  Because for a piece of bread a man will transgress.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:22: Proverbs 28:22 A man with an evil eye hastens after riches, And does not consider that poverty will come upon him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:23: Proverbs 28:23 He who rebukes a man will find more favor afterward Than he who flatters with the tongue.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:24: Proverbs 28:24 Whoever robs his father or his mother, And says, "It is no transgression," The same is companion to a destroyer.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:25: Proverbs 28:25 He who is of a proud heart stirs up strife,  But he who trusts in the LORD will be prospered.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:26: Proverbs 28:26 He who trusts in his own heart is a fool, But whoever walks wisely will be delivered.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:27: Proverbs 28:27 He who gives to the poor will not lack, But he who hides his eyes will have many curses.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 28:28: Proverbs 28:28 When the wicked arise, men hide themselves; But when they perish, the righteous increase.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:1: Proverbs 29:1 He  who is often rebuked, and hardens his neck, Will suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:2: Proverbs 29:2 When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice; But when a wicked man rules, the people groan.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:3: Proverbs 29:3 Whoever loves wisdom makes his father rejoice, But a companion of harlots wastes his wealth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:4: Proverbs 29:4 The king establishes the land by justice, But he who receives bribes overthrows it.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:5: Proverbs 29:5 A man who flatters his neighbor Spreads a net for his feet.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:6: Proverbs 29:6 By transgression an evil man is snared, But the righteous sings and rejoices.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:7: Proverbs 29:7 The righteous considers the cause of the poor, But the wicked does not understand such knowledge.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:8: Proverbs 29:8 Scoffers set a city aflame, But wise men turn away wrath.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:9: Proverbs 29:9 If a wise man contends with a foolish man,  Whether the fool rages or laughs, there is no peace.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:10: Proverbs 29:10 The bloodthirsty hate the blameless, But the upright seek his well-being.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:11: Proverbs 29:11 A fool vents all his feelings, But a wise man holds them back.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:12: Proverbs 29:12 If a ruler pays attention to lies, All his servants become wicked.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:13: Proverbs 29:13 The poor man and the oppressor have this in common:  The LORD gives light to the eyes of both.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:14: Proverbs 29:14 The king who judges the poor with truth, His throne will be established forever.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:15: Proverbs 29:15 The rod and rebuke give wisdom, But a child left to himself brings shame to his mother.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:16: Proverbs 29:16 When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increases; But the righteous will see their fall.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:17: Proverbs 29:17 Correct your son, and he will give you rest; Yes, he will give delight to your soul.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:18: Proverbs 29:18 Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; But happy is he who keeps the law.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:19: Proverbs 29:19 A servant will not be corrected by mere words; For though he understands, he will not respond.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:20: Proverbs 29:20 Do you see a man hasty in his words?  There is more hope for a fool than for him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:21: Proverbs 29:21 He who pampers his servant from childhood Will have him as a son in the end.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:22: Proverbs 29:22 An angry man stirs up strife, And a furious man abounds in transgression.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:23: Proverbs 29:23 A man's pride will bring him low, But the humble in spirit will retain honor.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:24: Proverbs 29:24 Whoever is a partner with a thief hates his own life;  He swears to tell the truth, but reveals nothing.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:25: Proverbs 29:25 The fear of man brings a snare, But whoever trusts in the LORD shall be safe.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:26: Proverbs 29:26 Many seek the ruler's favor, But justice for man comes from the LORD.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 29:27: Proverbs 29:27 An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous, And he who is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:1: Proverbs 30:1 The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, his utterance. This man declared to Ithiel"”to Ithiel and Ucal:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:2: Proverbs 30:2 Surely I am more stupid than any man, And do not have the understanding of a man.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:3: Proverbs 30:3 I neither learned wisdom Nor have knowledge of the Holy One.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:4: Proverbs 30:4 Who has ascended into heaven, or descended?  Who has gathered the wind in His fists? Who has bound the waters in a garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is His name, and what is His Son's name, If you know?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:5: Proverbs 30:5 Every word of God is pure;  He is a shield to those who put their trust in Him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:6: Proverbs 30:6 Do not add to His words, Lest He rebuke you, and you be found a liar.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:7: Proverbs 30:7 Two things I request of You (Deprive me not before I die):(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:8: Proverbs 30:8 Remove falsehood and lies far from me; Give me neither poverty nor riches"”  Feed me with the food allotted to me;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:9: Proverbs 30:9 Lest I be full and deny You, And say, "Who is the LORD?" Or lest I be poor and steal, And profane the name of my God.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:10: Proverbs 30:10 Do not malign a servant to his master, Lest he curse you, and you be found guilty.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:11: Proverbs 30:11 There is a generation that curses its father, And does not bless its mother.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:12: Proverbs 30:12 There is a generation that is pure in its own eyes, Yet is not washed from its filthiness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:13: Proverbs 30:13 There is a generation"”oh, how lofty are their eyes! And their eyelids are lifted up.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:14: Proverbs 30:14 There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, And whose fangs are like knives,  To devour the poor from off the earth, And the needy from among men.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:15: Proverbs 30:15 The leech has two daughters"” Give and Give! There are three things that are never satisfied, Four never say, "Enough!":(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:16: Proverbs 30:16 The grave, The barren womb, The earth that is not satisfied with water"” And the fire never says, "Enough!"(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:17: Proverbs 30:17 The eye that mocks his father, And scorns obedience to his mother, The ravens of the valley will pick it out, And the young eagles will eat it.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:18: Proverbs 30:18 There are three things which are too wonderful for me, Yes, four which I do not understand:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:19: Proverbs 30:19 The way of an eagle in the air, The way of a serpent on a rock, The way of a ship in the midst of the sea, And the way of a man with a virgin.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:20: Proverbs 30:20 This is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, And says, "I have done no wickedness."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:21: Proverbs 30:21 For three things the earth is perturbed, Yes, for four it cannot bear up:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:22: Proverbs 30:22 For a servant when he reigns, A fool when he is filled with food,(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:23: Proverbs 30:23 A hateful woman when she is married, And a maidservant who succeeds her mistress.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:24: Proverbs 30:24 There are four things which are little on the earth, But they are exceedingly wise:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:25: Proverbs 30:25 The ants are a people not strong, Yet they prepare their food in the summer;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:26: Proverbs 30:26 The rock badgers are a feeble folk, Yet they make their homes in the crags;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:27: Proverbs 30:27 The locusts have no king, Yet they all advance in ranks;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:28: Proverbs 30:28 The spider skillfully grasps with its hands, And it is in kings' palaces.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:29: Proverbs 30:29 There are three things which are majestic in pace, Yes, four which are stately in walk:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:30: Proverbs 30:30 A lion, which is mighty among beasts And does not turn away from any;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:31: Proverbs 30:31 A greyhound, A male goat also, And a king whose troops are with him.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:32: Proverbs 30:32 If you have been foolish in exalting yourself, Or if you have devised evil, put your hand on your mouth.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 30:33: Proverbs 30:33 For as the churning of milk produces butter, And wringing the nose produces blood, So the forcing of wrath produces strife.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:1: Proverbs 31:1 The words of King Lemuel, the utterance which his mother taught him:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:2: Proverbs 31:2 What, my son? And what, son of my womb? And what, son of my vows?(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:3: Proverbs 31:3 Do not give your strength to women, Nor your ways to that which destroys kings.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:4: Proverbs 31:4 It is not for kings, O Lemuel, It is not for kings to drink wine, Nor for princes intoxicating drink;(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:5: Proverbs 31:5 Lest they drink and forget the law, And pervert the justice of all the afflicted.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:6: Proverbs 31:6 Give strong drink to him who is perishing, And wine to those who are bitter of heart.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:7: Proverbs 31:7 Let him drink and forget his poverty, And remember his misery no more.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:8: Proverbs 31:8 Open your mouth for the speechless, In the cause of all who are appointed to die.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:9: Proverbs 31:9 Open your mouth, judge righteously, And plead the cause of the poor and needy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:10: Proverbs 31:10 Who can find a virtuous wife? For her worth is far above rubies.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:11: Proverbs 31:11 The heart of her husband safely trusts her; So he will have no lack of gain.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:12: Proverbs 31:12 She does him good and not evil All the days of her life.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:13: Proverbs 31:13 She seeks wool and flax, And willingly works with her hands.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:14: Proverbs 31:14 She is like the merchant ships, She brings her food from afar.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:15: Proverbs 31:15 She also rises while it is yet night, And provides food for her household, And a portion for her maidservants.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:16: Proverbs 31:16 She considers a field and buys it; From her profits she plants a vineyard.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:17: Proverbs 31:17 She girds herself with strength, And strengthens her arms.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:18: Proverbs 31:18 She perceives that her merchandise is good, And her lamp does not go out by night.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:19: Proverbs 31:19 She stretches out her hands to the distaff, And her hand holds the spindle.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:20: Proverbs 31:20 She extends her hand to the poor, Yes, she reaches out her hands to the needy.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:21: Proverbs 31:21 She is not afraid of snow for her household, For all her household is clothed with scarlet.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:22: Proverbs 31:22 She makes tapestry for herself; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:23: Proverbs 31:23 Her husband is known in the gates, When he sits among the elders of the land.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:24: Proverbs 31:24 She makes linen garments and sells them, And supplies sashes for the merchants.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:25: Proverbs 31:25 Strength and honor are her clothing; She shall rejoice in time to come.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:26: Proverbs 31:26 She opens her mouth with wisdom, And on her tongue is the law of kindness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:27: Proverbs 31:27 She watches over the ways of her household, And does not eat the bread of idleness.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:28: Proverbs 31:28 Her children rise up and call her blessed; Her husband also, and he praises her:(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:29: Proverbs 31:29 "Many daughters have done well, But you excel them all."(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:30: Proverbs 31:30 Charm is deceitful and beauty is passing, But a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.(NKJV)
verses.proverbs 31:31: Proverbs 31:31 Give her of the fruit of her hands, And let her own works praise her in the gates.(NKJV)
